# Discount & tax

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/discount/

Calculate the final price after a discount and an optional tax added to the discounted amount. See the savings and tax separately.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Apply a 15% discount to NPR 2500, then add 13% tax to the reduced price.

## Limits and checks

This tool applies discount first and tax second. A retailer may include tax in its displayed prices or use different rounding.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
